craft_evidence.reasoning: Most product pages place the making (USA, New York City, Los Angeles, hand-knit in New York or LA, knit in Wales), and fabric origins are given per piece. No maker, workshop or mill is named apart from the Shaniko wool, so it's a strong 2.
